QuestInfo.name: The Enemy's Goal
QuestInfo.0: We should return to Ereve immediately. What does Neinheart think of this situation?
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart is distressed that he cannot understand why they attacked Ereve while the Empress was away. What was their goal?
QuestInfo.2: Darkness has fallen over Ereve. In the wake of the attack, the island is in ruins. And in the center of it all is a gray-skinned man with purple hair. He is Damien, the villain who attacked Ereve!
